create.name: Master Alex Dong
create.bio:
Alex Dong is a fourth-generation master of the Dong (Tung) family style of Taijiquan, the lineage of his great-grandfather Dong Yingjie. He began formal training at the age of five with his father, Grand Master Dong Zeng Chen, in Hebei Province, and after moving to Honolulu at twelve he also studied with his grandfather, Grand Master Dong Hu Ling. He started assisting in his father's classes at fifteen, opened his own class in Hawaii in 1990, and in 1991 won the US national title in moving push hands. In 2003 he moved to New York City and founded the Alex Dong International Taijiquan Association.

His teaching covers the family's slow, fast, Fa-Jing and Kai-He (Hao) forms, push hands, weapons and foundational qigong, along with shorter Simplified and Advanced forms he created himself. He teaches weekly classes in New York, live and recorded lessons online, and seminars across the United States, Europe and Asia, and he sells his instructional videos through his own site. He founded the Tung Ying Jie Taiji Legacy, translated much of his great-grandfather's Taijiquan Explained (the Red Book), and co-wrote Grand Master, a biography of Dong Yingjie, with David Saltman.

books.title: Grand Master: The Story of Dong Ying Jie, Tai Chi Champion of China
books.author: Alex Dong, David Saltman
books.description: A biography of Dong Yingjie, one of the best-known Taijiquan masters of the twentieth century, compiled and translated from original sources by his great-grandson Alex Dong and edited by David Saltman. It follows his training and teaching life and was the first detailed account of it in English.

courses.title: Master Alex Dong: Simplified and Advance Tai Chi
courses.description: Downloadable video lessons in the two shorter Dong-style forms Alex Dong created: the Simplified form, which takes eight to twelve minutes, and the more demanding Advanced form. Suited to students who want a full practice without the long form.

courses.title: Tai Chi Fundamental QiGongs 1 & 2 and QiGongs 3
courses.description: Video instruction in the three foundational qigong exercises Alex Dong teaches before the forms. They work on opening the body, moving as one unit and keeping the lower body rooted while the upper body turns.

courses.title: Dong Style Taiji – Yang Slow Form
courses.description: Downloadable video of the traditional Dong family slow form, the long Yang-style set at the centre of the lineage. A reference for learning and refining the sequence at home.

courses.title: Dong Family Fast Form
courses.description: Downloadable video of the Dong family fast form, a quicker set that brings speed and release of power into Taiji practice. Best for students who already know the slow form.

courses.title: Dong Family Kai-He (Hao) Form
courses.description: Video instruction in the Kai-He (opening and closing) form preserved in the Dong family, which draws on Hao-style Taiji. A compact set focused on internal opening and closing.

courses.title: Dong Style Taiji – Weapons Set
courses.description: Downloadable videos of the Dong-style Taiji weapons forms. They apply the same body principles as the empty-hand sets to traditional weapons.

courses.title: Dong Style Taiji Sticks
courses.description: Video instruction in the Dong-style double sticks form. A weapons set for students who want to take their form practice further.

courses.title: Three Qigong Treasures
courses.description: A downloadable set of three qigong practices from Alex Dong's online catalogue. A short daily routine that can be done alongside Taiji.

courses.title: Dong Style Tai Chi Classes – Fast Form
courses.description: A step-by-step online course in the Dong-style fast form, delivered on Vimeo over about twenty weekly lessons. Students contact Alex Dong to join.

courses.title: Rosendale Workshop, New York
courses.description: A four-day in-person Taiji and qigong workshop with Alex Dong in Rosendale, New York. Registration is by email through his workshops page.
